title: Live By Priority
coreMove: Translate purpose into one ordered first claim that tells every other worthy claim to wait.
sourcePressure: Part 3 turns purpose into priority, the ordered first claim that prevents many worthy items from remaining equally active.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Sorting a to-do list while keeping many priorities equally alive.

hook: A single choice changes the whole day
The real priority is hiding under the busy work
Live By Priority as a generic focus opener
counterintuition: Focus is harder than it looks
tryThisNow: Set a timer and list priorities
Write down your one thing without a concrete context
examples: generic office worker choosing email or strategy

exampleSpecs.domain: conservation crew restoring a salmon stream
exampleSpecs.stakes: grant inspectors arrive in six weeks
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she chooses culvert clearing before signage because fish passage serves the restoration purpose first
exampleSpecs.firstImage: muddy waders beside a culvert blocked with branches

exampleSpecs.stakes: sales, displays, and clubs all demand attention
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he puts the teen book club first because the store's purpose is neighborhood reading habit, not prettier tables
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a folding chair circle between half-filled display shelves

exampleSpecs.stakes: training, newsletters, and family calls compete
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she names family presence as the purpose and moves call coverage ahead of the newsletter everyone likes
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a volunteer phone tree pinned over a half-designed newsletter

exampleSpecs.stakes: the robot can be made prettier or made reliable
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she orders drive-train repair before sponsor decals because the purpose is a robot that completes the task
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a loose drive belt hanging beside glossy sponsor decals

exampleSpecs.stakes: packaging design and roast consistency both need work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he predicts packaging will drive launch buzz, then lets the quality purpose put roast calibration first
exampleSpecs.firstImage: green coffee samples beside a matte black label mockup

exampleSpecs.stakes: booths, flyers, and appointment slots all seem important
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she sees priority meant reserving attorney slots first because unanswered legal questions were the event's reason to exist
exampleSpecs.firstImage: appointment cards clipped to a folding table with untouched flyers

skillTargets: use priority as a first claim rather than a label

tryThisNowSpec: Put your purpose sentence above your task list and move one item into the first position because it serves that sentence best.
